functions.name: ProcessCharacterTierRewards
functions.comment:
Processes character tier rewards by checking NPC trade flags and removing quest items.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer from unit
2. Get bit array from player class at offset based on context+0x4D index
3. Check if NPC trade flag (10, 0) is already set - if so, early return
4. Get room from unit, verify it exists
5. Get entity field (experience/level info) from room
6. Check if character tier index is 1 (specific tier)
7. If tier matches:
   a. Set NPC trade flag bits (10, 0) and (10, 0xD)
   b. Check if player has a target unit selected
   c. If no target selected, remove quest items:
      - Remove item with stat 0x20747368 ("hst " - quest/hotspot item)
      - Remove item with stat 0x20706976 ("vip " - VIP quest item)
      - Remove item with stat 0x2066736d ("msf " - mission item)

Parameters:
  nGameContext (ECX) - Game context pointer with index at +0x4D
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit pointer (UnitAny*)

Returns:
  void

Magic Numbers:
  0x20747368 - "hst " ASCII (hotspot/quest stat identifier)
  0x20706976 - "vip " ASCII (VIP quest stat identifier)
  0x2066736d - "msf " ASCII (mission stat identifier)
  10 - NPC trade flag row index
  0xD - Secondary flag column index

Note: RET 0x4 indicates one stack parameter was passed (callee cleanup)

functions.name: HandleNpcInteractionState
functions.comment:
Handles NPC interaction state transitions for player-NPC interactions.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID 0xD from game context
2. If no client found, return 0
3. Find NPC unit in game list and get player client data
4. Check interaction mode at param_1[1]+0xC:
   - Mode 0: Check if unit is in transaction, if so return 1
             If player has "hst " stat item, setup trade interaction
             Otherwise set interaction mode 0x12 and return 1
   - Mode 1: If found unit matches target, clear target/skill mode and return 0
   - Other modes: Return 0
5. For trade setup: set interaction state, animation mode 1, send packet 0x58

Parameters:
  pContext (ECX) - Pointer to context structure:
    [0] - Game instance pointer
    [4] - NPC unit pointer
    [8] - Player unit pointer

Returns:
  int - 1 if interaction handled successfully, 0 otherwise

Packet Structure (7 bytes):
  Offset  Size  Field       Value
  0x00    1     nPacketId   0x58
  0x01    4     dwUnitGUID  NPC unit GUID
  0x05    1     bState      0x00

Magic Numbers:
  0x20747368 - " tsh" stat value identifier (trade/shop related)
  0x12 - Interaction mode for non-trade NPC interaction
  0x58 - Packet type for NPC interaction state

functions.name: CheckPlayerInteractionAllowed
functions.comment:
Checks if player interaction is allowed by iterating through players and checking state flags.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID 0xD from game context
2. If client not found, return false
3. Get client data at client+0x18
4. If flag at client_data+0x3D is set, return true (interaction always allowed)
5. If flag at client_data+0x0F is not set, return false
6. Otherwise:
   a. Clear result byte at client_data+0x44
   b. Store dwParam at client_data+0x40
   c. Call IteratePlayersCallback with FUN_6fcc3190 callback
   d. Return true if client_data+0x44 is still 0 (no conflicts found)

Parameters:
  nGamePtr (ECX) - Game instance pointer
  dwParam (EDX) - Parameter value stored for callback use

Returns:
  bool - true if interaction is allowed, false otherwise

Client Data Offsets:
  +0x0F - Interaction enabled flag
  +0x3D - Always-allow flag (bypass checks)
  +0x40 - Parameter storage for callback
  +0x44 - Result flag (set by callback if conflict found)

functions.name: CheckUnitProximityCallback
functions.signature: void CheckUnitProximityCallback(int nGame, UnitAny * pUnit, int pContext)
functions.comment:
Callback function that checks if a unit is within proximity range of a target unit.

Algorithm:
1. Get target unit from context structure at offset +0x40
2. Calculate approximate distance between pUnit and target
3. If distance < 12 (0xC), set found flag at context+0x44 to 1

Parameters:
  nGame (ECX) - Game instance pointer (unused)
  pUnit (EDX) - Unit to check distance from
  pContext (stack) - Context structure pointer:
    [+0x40] - Target unit pointer (UnitAny*)
    [+0x44] - Found/proximity flag (byte, set to 1 if within range)

Returns:
  void (result stored in context+0x44)

Magic Numbers:
  0xC (12) - Maximum proximity distance threshold

Notes:
  This is a party/unit iteration callback used to find units within
  a specified range of a target. The caller iterates units and this
  callback marks the context when a unit is found within range.

functions.name: InitQuestHandlerStruct
functions.comment:
Initializes a QuestHandler structure with default callbacks and allocates quest buffer memory.

Algorithm:
1. Zero out 60 bytes of handler callback table at offset 0xA0 (15 DWORDs)
2. Set reward stats callback at offset 0xA0 to HandleQuestItemRewardStats
3. Clear flag bytes at offsets 0x0B and 0x0C
4. Set object activation callback at offset 0xCC to HandleQuestObjectActivation
5. Set null callback at offset 0xC0 to NullQuestCallback
6. Set timer data pointer at offset 0xDC to g_QuestTimerData
7. Set initialization flag byte at offset 0x0A to 1
8. Allocate 194 (0xC2) bytes of pool memory for quest buffer
9. Store allocated buffer pointer at offset 0x18 and zero first byte
10. Set handler count at offset 0xE0 to 30 (0x1E)
11. Set handler table pointer at offset 0xE4 to NullHandlerCallback
12. Set trade condition callback at offset 0xE8 to CheckQuestGambleTradeCondition

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Pointer to QuestHandler structure to initialize

Returns:
  void - Structure is initialized in-place

Structure Layout (QuestHandler offsets):
  Offset  Size  Field                     Description
  0x04    4     pGameData                 Pointer to game data (read for pool ID)
  0x0A    1     bInitialized              Initialization complete flag (set to 1)
  0x0B    1     bReserved1                Reserved/cleared
  0x0C    1     bReserved2                Reserved/cleared
  0x18    4     pQuestBuffer              Allocated quest buffer (194 bytes)
  0xA0    60    aCallbackTable            Callback function table (15 ptrs, zeroed then set)
  0xC0    4     pfnNullCallback           Null/empty callback function
  0xCC    4     pfnObjectActivation       Object activation callback
  0xDC    4     pTimerData                Pointer to global timer data
  0xE0    4     dwHandlerCount            Number of handlers (30)
  0xE4    4     pfnHandlerTable           Handler table function pointer
  0xE8    4     pfnTradeCondition         Trade condition check callback

Magic Numbers:
  0x0F (15)   - Number of DWORDs in callback table
  0xC2 (194)  - Size of quest buffer allocation
  0x1E (30)   - Handler count value

functions.name: HandleQuestObjectActivation
functions.comment:
Handles quest object activation events and updates quest progress bits.

Algorithm:
1. Check if event object class ID is 0x179 (377 - quest-specific object)
2. If not matching, return without action
3. Get game instance from pEventData[0], event subtype from pEventData[6]
4. Get player monster class pointer from pEventData[3]
5. Check event subtype:
   - If 0x3B (59) or 0x3C (60): Set bit 13 at index 0x1E (30) and install FUN_6fcc3330 handler

2. If not matching type, exit early
3. Check quest enabled flag at [ECX+0x9]
4. If not enabled, exit early
5. Check progress level at [ECX+0xC] is less than 3
6. If progress >= 3, exit early (already at max)
7. Call SetQuestStateWithDebug with state 0x14F and flag 1

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX) - Quest data structure pointer
  pUnit (EDX) - Unit triggering validation

Returns: void

Special Cases:
  - Early exit if unit type != 0x4D
  - Early exit if quest not enabled
  - Early exit if progress >= 3

Magic Numbers:
  0x4D (77) - Quest NPC unit type
  0x14F (335) - Quest state debug code
  3 - Maximum progress threshold

functions.name: ValidateAndSendQuestState

functions.name: ValidatePartyMemberTradeFlagsCallback
functions.comment:
Callback function for IteratePartyMembers that validates NPC trade flags for a party member.

Algorithm:
1. Call FindClientById with nClientId to get client structure pointer
2. If client not found (NULL), exit early
3. Get player monster class pointer from the unit via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
4. Read trade flag slot index from unit offset +0x4D
5. Get trade flags array pointer from client structure at [pClient + nSlotIndex*4 + 0x10]
6. Check if trade flag index 0 in type group 0x13 is NOT set via IsNpcTradeFlagSet
7. If any flag IS set, exit early (trade validation fails)
8. Check if trade flag index 6 in type group 0x13 is NOT set
9. Check if trade flag index 8 in type group 0x13 is NOT set
10. Check if trade flag index 7 in type group 0x13 is NOT set
11. Get room pointer via GetRoom for the unit
12. If room is NULL, exit early
13. Get entity field from room via GetEntityField
14. Get character tier index via GetCharacterTierIndex
15. If tier index equals 2, set bit in 2D array at row 0x13, column 6 via SetBitInArray2D

Parameters:
  nClientId: Client identifier passed in ECX (IMPLICIT __fastcall)
  pUnit: Pointer to UnitAny structure passed in EDX (IMPLICIT __fastcall)

Returns:
  void: No return value, modifies trade flag state as side effect

Special Cases:
  - Returns immediately if FindClientById returns NULL
  - Returns immediately if any of the four trade flag checks succeed (flag is set)
  - Returns immediately if GetRoom returns NULL
  - Only sets the bit if character tier index equals 2 (0x02)

Magic Numbers:
  - 0x11 (17): Client type ID for FindClientById
  - 0x4D (77): Offset in unit structure for trade slot index
  - 0x10 (16): Base offset in client for trade flags array
  - 0x13 (19): Trade flag type group identifier
  - 0, 6, 7, 8: Trade flag indices checked in sequence
  - 0x02: Character tier threshold for setting bit

functions.name: ValidateGoldBankNpcTradeFlags
functions.comment:
Validates NPC trade flags for Gold Bank (g33) interactions.

Algorithm:
1. Find client by ID and get player monster class pointer
2. Get player inventory stat array at offset based on difficulty (byte 0x4d)
3. Check if NPC trade flag 0 is set for stat 0x13 - if so, exit early
4. Check if NPC trade flag 6 is set for stat 0x13 - if so, exit early
5. Find inventory item by stat value 0x11 (Gold Bank marker)
6. If item found, check for g33 type identifier match
7. If g33 matches, set bit 5 in array and return 0
8. Otherwise check item data byte at offset 0x18 for quest state
9. Set appropriate bits (2, 3, 4) based on quest completion state

Parameters:
  pGame - Game instance pointer (ECX, IMPLICIT)
  nClientId - Client identifier to validate

Returns:
  Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x13 - NPC trade stat ID for Gold Bank
  0x11 - Stat value for Gold Bank inventory lookup
  0x20333367 - "g33 " type identifier (Gold Bank)
  0x4d - Difficulty byte offset in player structure

functions.name: CheckSkillsAndSendQuestStatePacket
functions.comment:

2. Read character class index from player structure offset 0x4d
3. Get skill table pointer from class data [EAX + classIndex*4 + 0x10]
4. Check trade flag type 0x13 (skills), index 0x0 - if not set, check index 0xf
5. If either 0x0 or 0xf set, check indices 0xd and 0xe
6. If 0xd not set but 0xe is set, send quest state packet (quest 0x11)
7. Return 0

Parameters:

  pPlayer (EDX) - Pointer to player unit structure

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Called By: Quest system handlers
Calls: GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr, IsNpcTradeFlagSet, SendQuestStatePacketToPlayer

functions.name: CollectQuestNpcStats
functions.comment:
Collects quest NPC stats based on trade flags and adds them to a stat list.

Algorithm:
1. Get monster class data for the quest unit
2. Retrieve NPC trade flags from monster class table
3. Check primary trade flag (type 0x13, index 0)
4. If primary flag set and unit in array, collect stats with table index 4
5. Otherwise check for inventory item with stat value 0x20333367
6. Based on trade flags (indices 5, 6, 7, 8), determine stat table index:
   - Flag 6 set + flag 7 clear + stat type 0xFC: use index 5
   - Flag 6 set + flag 8 clear + stat type 0xFF: use index 6
   - Flag 6 set + flag 7 clear: use index 5
   - Flag 6 set + flag 8 clear: use index 6
   - Flag 5 set + flag 8 clear + item found: use index 3
   - Flag 5 set: use index 4
   - Default: lookup index from g_awData table based on game state

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX): Game context structure pointer
  pQuestContext (EDX): Quest context containing unit and stat list data

Returns:
  void - Stats added to linked list at pQuestContext[5]

Trade Flag Indices (Type 0x13):
  0: Primary quest completion flag
  5: Secondary reward available
  6: Tertiary reward available
  7: Special reward type A blocked
  8: Special reward type B blocked

Magic Numbers:
  0x20333367: Inventory stat value for special item check
  0xFC: Stat type for special reward A
  0xFF: Stat type for special reward B
  0x4D: Offset to quest index in first context element

functions.name: ValidateNpcTradeFlagsQuest19Callback
functions.comment:
Callback to validate NPC trade flags for Quest 19 (Rescue on Mount Arreat) during unit iteration.

Algorithm:
  1. Extract player index from pPlayerData structure at offset 0x4D
  2. Get NPC trade flag array using player monster class lookup
  3. Check trade flag bit 0 for quest 0x13 (19) - if set, quest already complete
  4. Check trade flag bit 6 - item obtained phase
  5. Check trade flag bit 8 - completion acknowledged phase
  6. Check trade flag bit 7 - reward received phase
  7. If any early-exit condition found (bits 0, 6, 8, 7 progression), return 0
  8. On progression mismatch (bit 7 set but not 8), perform special validation

Parameters:
  pPlayerData (ECX): Pointer to player data structure containing unit reference
  pUnitData (EDX): Pointer to unit being validated in iteration (unused directly)

Returns:
  int - 0 to continue iteration or stop when condition met

Magic Numbers:
  0x13 (19) - Quest ID for Rescue on Mount Arreat / Rite of Passage
  0x4D     - Offset to player index byte in player data structure
  Bit 0    - Quest completed flag
  Bit 6    - Quest item obtained flag
  Bit 7    - Quest reward received flag
  Bit 8    - Quest completion acknowledged flag

Called By:
  HandleQuestObjectEvent (0x6fcc6230) via IterateUnitsWithCallback

BOUNDARY NOTE: Function may have malformed boundaries in Ghidra (single instruction).
Full code runs from 0x6fcc64f0 to 0x6fcc6561 (RET 4 at 0x6fcc655e).

functions.name: HandleQuestStateUpdate
functions.comment:
Handles quest state updates triggered by game events.

Algorithm:
1. Extract event value from pEventContext+0x8
2. Retrieve state buffer pointer from pGameObject+0x18
3. Call event validation function with extracted value
4. Compare result against magic value 0x20333367 ("g33 ")
5. If validation passes, decrement counter at state_buffer+0x1C
6. If counter reaches zero and state is active:
   a. Check quest flags at pGameObject+0x9 and +0xC
   b. If conditions met, set completion flag at state_buffer+0x20

Parameters:
  pGameObject (ECX): GameObject pointer with state buffer at offset 0x18
  pEventContext (EDX): Event context with trigger value at offset 0x8

Returns:
  void - State updated in place via state buffer modifications

Magic Numbers:
  0x20333367: Validation success code ("g33 " in ASCII, little-endian)
  0x1C: Counter offset in state buffer
  0x20: Completion flag offset in state buffer

Structure Layout (state buffer at pGameObject+0x18):
  Offset  Size  Field            Description
  0x00    1     bStateActive     Active state flag
  0x1C    4     dwEventCounter   Countdown counter for events
  0x20    1     bCompletionFlag  Set to 1 when quest condition met

Note: Handler installed at offset 0xC4 in game object handler table.
Called from InitGameObjectHandlers during object initialization.

functions.name: SpawnQuestMonster
functions.comment:
Spawns quest monsters based on quest data and client state.

Algorithm:
1. Look up client by quest type ID (0x11) via FindClientById
2. If client not found, set animation mode 2 and return
3. Check handler enabled flag at client offset 0x9
4. If disabled, set animation mode 2 and return
5. Access state buffer at offset 0x18 and set activation flag
6. Copy quest coordinates from pQuestData offsets 0x14, 0x18 to state buffer
7. If spawn conditions met (state flags at offsets 0x3, 0x2)
8. Call SpawnMonsterFromData with monster type 0x197 (407)
9. Update state buffer with spawn result and unit ID

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX): Pointer to quest data structure containing:
    [0x00] pGame - Game instance pointer
    [0x04] pUnit - Unit pointer for animation fallback
    [0x08] dwMonsterClass - Monster class for spawn
    [0x14] dwSpawnX - X coordinate for spawn
    [0x18] dwSpawnY - Y coordinate for spawn

Magic Numbers:
  0x11 - Quest handler type ID
  0x197 (407) - Monster type ID for quest spawn
  0x2 - Animation mode for failed spawn

functions.name: GetQuestTargetPosition
functions.comment:
Retrieves quest target position coordinates from quest state buffer.

Algorithm:
1. Call FindClientById with quest type 0x11 (17) to get quest client
2. If quest client not found, return false (0)
3. Get state buffer pointer from quest client offset 0x18
4. Check if position validity flag at state buffer offset 0x6 is set
5. If flag not set, return false (0)
6. Copy X coordinate from state buffer offset 0x10 to pnPosition[0]
7. Copy Y coordinate from state buffer offset 0x14 to pnPosition[1]
8. Return true (1) indicating success

Parameters:
  nClientId (ECX): Client ID used for quest client lookup
  pnPosition (EDX): Output buffer pointer for position coordinates
    [0]: X coordinate (4 bytes)
    [1]: Y coordinate (4 bytes)

Returns:
  true (1): Quest target position retrieved successfully
  false (0): Quest client not found or position not yet set

Structure Layout (Quest State Buffer at client+0x18):
  Offset  Size  Field         Description
  0x06    1     bPositionSet  Position validity flag (1=valid, 0=invalid)
  0x10    4     nTargetX      Target X coordinate in world space
  0x14    4     nTargetY      Target Y coordinate in world space

Magic Numbers:
  0x11 (17): Quest type ID for FindClientById lookup

functions.name: SetQuestTargetAndAnimate
functions.comment:
Sets quest target position and triggers unit animation.

3. If quest client not found, return
4. Get state buffer pointer from quest client offset 0x18
5. Get game pointer from interaction data offset 4
6. Copy unit ID from game[8] to state buffer offset 0x28
7. Copy X coordinate from interaction[0x14] to state buffer[0x10]
8. Copy Y coordinate from interaction[0x18] to state buffer[0x14]

    [0x00]: Client pointer
    [0x04]: Game pointer (unit structure)
    [0x14]: Target X coordinate
    [0x18]: Target Y coordinate

Returns:
  void

  0x10    4     nTargetX      Target X coordinate
  0x14    4     nTargetY      Target Y coordinate
  0x28    4     dwUnitId      Target unit ID
  0x2c    4     nAnimMode     Animation mode to apply

functions.name: HandleQuestNpcDialog
functions.comment:
Handles quest NPC dialog interactions based on quest state and NPC type.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class from unit at interaction[0xc]
2. Extract player index from client at offset 0x4d
3. Get quest bit array from monster class
4. Get NPC ID from interaction[8]+4
5. Check NPC trade flag 0 for quest 0x14 (20)
6. If flag 0 set:
   - Check if value in quest array via IsValueInArray
   - If yes, call CollectStatsByTypeToList with action 6
   - Return
7. If NPC ID is 0xFE (254), check state buffer byte 0
8. Check NPC trade flag 1 for quest 0x14
9. If flag 1 set, call CollectStatsByTypeToList with action 5, return
10. Search inventory for item with stat 0x20343367 ('g34 ')
11. If found and NPC is 0xF5 (245), check flag 4, call action 3
12. If found and NPC is 0xFE (254), check flags 0 and 1, call action 2
13. Search inventory for item with stat 0x2034336a ('j34 ')
14. If found, check flag 2 and NPC IDs 0xF5/0xFC (252)
15. Call appropriate action codes (0, 1, 2, 7) based on state

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX): Quest information structure pointer
  pInteraction (EDX): Interaction data array
    [0]: Client pointer
    [8]: Unit pointer (NPC ID at +4)
    [0xc]: Player unit pointer
    [0x14]: Action parameter for CollectStatsByTypeToList

Returns:
  void - Actions performed through CollectStatsByTypeToList

Magic Numbers:
  0x14 (20): Quest ID for flag checks
  0xF5 (245): NPC ID - Cain
  0xFC (252): NPC ID - Warriv
  0xFE (254): NPC ID - Charsi
  0x20343367: Stat ID 'g34 ' (little-endian)
  0x2034336a: Stat ID 'j34 ' (little-endian)

functions.name: ValidateAndSendQuestState
functions.comment:
Validates quest state flags and sends quest state packet to player if conditions are met.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class from unit via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
2. Get quest bit array from monster class using player index at client+0x4d
3. Check NPC trade flag 0 for quest 0x14 (20)
4. If flag 0 not set, check flag 0xf (15)
5. If flag 0 or 0xf is set, check flag 0xd (13)
6. If flag 0xd not set, check flag 0xe (14)
7. If conditions met (flags 0 or 0xf set AND (0xd not set OR 0xe set)):
   - Call SendQuestStatePacketToPlayer with mode 0x12 (18)
8. Return 0

Parameters:
  pClient (ECX): Client pointer for player index lookup (offset 0x4d)
  pUnit (EDX): Unit pointer for monster class retrieval

Returns:
  0 always

Magic Numbers:
  0x14 (20): Quest ID for NPC trade flag checks
  0x12 (18): Quest state packet mode
  0x4d: Player index offset in client structure
  Flags checked: 0, 0xf (15), 0xd (13), 0xe (14)

Logic Summary:
  Send packet if: (flag0 || flag15) && (!flag13 || flag14)

functions.name: GetQuestType18StateData
functions.comment:
Returns the allocated state data buffer for quest type 18.

Algorithm:
1. Read state data pointer from quest object offset 0x18
2. Return pointer in EAX

Parameters:
  pQuestObject (ECX): Quest object pointer

Returns:
  void* - Pointer to 28-byte state buffer allocated during InitQuestType18Handlers

Notes:
  - This is a handler installed at quest object offset 0xc4
  - State buffer is allocated via AllocPoolMemoryTracked (28 bytes)
  - Buffer contains quest progression flags at offsets 0x1, 0xc

functions.name: CheckQuestItemsAndTransitionState
functions.comment:
Checks for quest items in player inventory and transitions quest state.

Algorithm:
1. Get state data buffer from quest object at offset 0x18
2. Search inventory for item with hash 0x2034336a (first quest item)
3. If found, increment item counter at state buffer offset 0x10
4. Search inventory for item with hash 0x20343367 (second quest item)
5. If found, increment item counter at state buffer offset 0x10
6. If exactly one item found AND quest enabled (offset 0x9) AND state flag (offset 0x15) set:
   a. Clear state flag at buffer offset 0x15
   b. Clear quest object flag at offset 0x14
   c. Set new state to 1 (first item) or 3 (second item)
   d. Call SetQuestStateAndIterate with ValidateAndSendQuestState callback

Parameters:
  pQuestObject (ECX): Quest handler object pointer
  pUnit (EDX): Player unit with inventory to search

Returns:
  void

Magic Numbers:
  0x2034336a - First quest item stat value hash
  0x20343367 - Second quest item stat value hash
  0x6fcc75e0 - ValidateAndSendQuestState callback address

State Buffer Layout (at pQuestObject+0x18):
  Offset  Size  Field           Description
  0x10    4     nItemsFound     Counter for matching items
  0x15    1     bStateFlag      State transition flag (cleared on transition)

functions.name: ClearMonsterTierCallbackState
functions.comment:
ClearMonsterTierCallbackState - Clears tier callback state when unit ID matches.

Algorithm:
1. Get tier callback structure pointer from pMonsterClass+0x18
2. Check if state byte at offset +2 equals 1 (active)
3. Compare dword at offset +4 with pUnit[2] (unit ID at +8)
4. If both conditions met, clear state (+2=0) and set processed flag (+1=1)

Parameters:
- pMonsterClass: Pointer to monster class data (ECX, __fastcall)
- pUnit: Unit pointer, ID at offset +8 (EDX, __fastcall)

Returns:
- void

Structure Layout (Tier Callback at pMonsterClass+0x18):
Offset  Size  Field        Description
0x00    4     pOwner       Parent structure pointer
0x01    1     bProcessed   Set to 1 when callback processed
0x02    1     bActive      State flag (1=active, 0=cleared)
0x04    4     dwUnitId     Unit ID to match against

Called By:
- HandleMonsterTierCallback: When monster meets tier 2 + type 0x14 conditions

functions.name: IsPetClientActive
functions.comment:
Checks if pet client (ID 0x12) is active and valid.

Algorithm:
1. Calls FindClientById with nClientId=0x12 (pet client)
2. Checks if client pointer is non-null
3. Dereferences client+0x18 to get state pointer
4. Returns 1 if state byte is non-zero, 0 otherwise

Parameters:
pGame - Pointer to game structure (ECX, __fastcall)

Returns:
1 if pet client is active and valid, 0 otherwise

functions.name: SetNpcTradeFlagsFromMonsterClass
functions.comment:
Sets NPC trade flags based on monster class information for a client.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer from game state
2. Load slot index from game state offset 0x4d
3. Get client ID from monster class array at [EAX + slot*4 + 0x10]
4. Call FindClientById to check if trade flag 0x15 is already set
5. If flag already set (result == 1), skip to end
6. Call GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr with param 0x13 to get monster info
7. If monster info is null, skip to end
8. Check monster type byte at offset 0xc
9. If type is 2 or 3, call SetBitInArray2D(clientId, 0x15, 0x2)
10. Check link flag byte at offset 0x18+0x5
11. If link flag is non-zero, call SetBitInArray2D(clientId, 0x15, 0x3)
12. Return 0

Parameters:
  pGameState (ECX) - Pointer to GameState structure containing player info
  nClientId (EDX) - Client identifier passed on stack

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - NPC trade flag array index
  0x4d - Slot index offset in GameState
  0x13 - Monster class type parameter for lookup
  0x10 - Base offset in monster class array
  0x2 - Trade flag bit for monster types 2-3
  0x3 - Trade flag bit for linked monsters
  0xc - Monster type byte offset
  0x18 - Link structure offset
  0x5 - Link flag byte offset within link structure

functions.name: CheckNpcTradeFlagsAndSendQuestState
functions.comment:
Checks NPC trade flags for quest 0x15 and conditionally sends quest state packet.

Algorithm:
1. Call GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr to get monster class data
2. Load client slot index from [pClient + 0x4d]
3. Get client ID from monster class array at [ptr + slot*4 + 0x10]
4. Check IsNpcTradeFlagSet for flag 0 on quest 0x15
5. If flag 0 not set, check flag 0xf (15)
6. If either flag 0 or 0xf set, check flags 0xd and 0xe
7. If flag 0xd not set but 0xe is set, call SendQuestStatePacketToPlayer with param 0x13
8. Return 0

Parameters:
  pClient - Client structure pointer (ECX, __fastcall)
  pnQuestData - Quest data pointer (EDX, __fastcall)

Returns:
  Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - Quest ID (Act 5 quest)
  0x13 - Quest state packet type
  0x4d - Client slot index offset
  0x10 - Monster class array base offset

functions.name: CheckSkillStatRequirements
functions.comment:
Checks if a unit meets the stat requirements to use a skill.
Validates trade flags and character tier before updating skill availability stats.

Algorithm:
1. Get player/monster class pointer from the unit
2. Read skill slot index from offset 0x4D of skill data
3. Index into class data array to get stat bit array pointer
4. Check trade flag at stat ID 0x15 with value 0 - early exit if set
5. Check trade flag at stat ID 0x15 with value 4 - early exit if set
6. Get room from unit and validate it exists
7. Get entity field from room and validate non-zero
8. Get character tier index and check if tier equals 2
9. Check trade flag at stat ID 0x12 with value 0
10. Set stat ID 0x15 to value 4 if flag clear, else 0
11. Set stat ID 0x0D (13) to finalize determination

Parameters:
  nSkillDataOffset (int) - Offset into skill data structure, ECX (IMPLICIT __fastcall)
  pUnit (void*) - Pointer to the unit being checked, EDX (IMPLICIT __fastcall)

Returns:
  void - No return value; results written to unit stat bit arrays

Magic Numbers:
  0x4D - Offset to skill slot index byte in skill data
  0x15 (21) - Primary trade flag stat ID
  0x12 (18) - Secondary requirement check stat ID  
  0x0D (13) - Final determination stat ID
  0x02 - Required character tier for stat updates

Calling Convention: __fastcall with RET 4 (4-byte stack cleanup)

functions.name: ProcessQuestRewardCompletion
functions.comment:
Processes quest reward completion and removes quest-related items.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer and character slot index
2. Retrieve item from player's inventory slot array
3. Check if NPC trade flag (0x12) is already set - exit if so
4. Validate unit has a room and character tier is 2 (nightmare+)
5. Set completion bits in 2D array for stats 0x12 and 0xD
6. If no target unit selected, remove quest items:
   - "qey " (0x20796571) - Quest eye item
   - "qhr " (0x20726871) - Quest heart item
   - "qbr " (0x20726271) - Quest brain item
   - "qf1 " (0x20316671) - Quest flag 1 item
   - "qf2 " (0x20326671) - Quest flag 2 item
7. Check stat 0x15 flags for additional processing

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit receiving reward

Returns: void (stack cleanup 4 bytes)

Magic Numbers:
  0x12 - NPC trade flag stat ID
  0xD  - Secondary stat flag
  0x15 - Tertiary stat flag
  0x4D - Character slot index offset
  0x2  - Nightmare+ character tier requirement

functions.name: UpdateCouncilQuestUnitAnimation
functions.comment:
Updates unit animation mode based on Council quest state.

Algorithm:
1. Get quest client for Council quest (ID 0x13)
2. Read quest stage byte at client data offset 0xC
3. If stage is non-zero, set unit animation mode to 2

Parameters:
  ppContext (ECX) - Pointer to context array:
    [0] = Game state pointer
    [4] = Unit pointer to animate

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x13 - Council quest ID
  0x0C - Quest stage offset in client data
  0x02 - Animation mode (active/triggered)

functions.name: HandleLamEsenQuestStateCallback
functions.comment:
Handles Lam Esen quest state callback for stat collection.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer and trade flags array
2. Check NPC trade flag 0x15 for bits 0, 0xD, and 4
3. If bit 4 set and quest data offset 0xC is 0, collect stats type 5
4. If bit 0 set and player not in value array, early return
5. For quest states < 6, use lookup table to determine stat type index
6. For quest states >= 6 with bit 0xD set, collect stats type 6

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX) - Quest handler structure pointer
  pQuestContext (EDX) - Quest context with game/player data

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - NPC trade flag stat ID for Lam Esen quest
  0x4D - Character slot index offset in game data
  0x38 - Quest ID offset in handler structure
  DAT_6fd3f3f0 - Quest state to stat type lookup table

functions.name: HandleLamEsenQuestProgress
functions.comment:
Handles progress events for Lam Esen's Tome quest.

Algorithm:
1. Check message type at offset 0x14:
   - 0x52: Quest initialization message
   - 0x4B: Progress update message
2. For init message (0x52):
   - Verify quest is active and not yet started
   - Set quest state byte at 0xC to 1
   - Install state callback at offset 0xA8
3. For progress message (0x4B):
   - Remove unit GUID from tracking array
   - Verify quest state is 2 or 3 (in progress)
   - Get player monster class and check trade flags
   - Skip if NPC trade flag already set for secondary quest
   - Update quest state based on progress stage
   - Schedule unit iteration callback

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX) - Quest handler structure
  pMessage (EDX) - Quest message structure

Returns: void

Message Structure (pMessage):
  Offset  Size  Field       Description
  0x00    4     pGame       Game pointer
  0x0C    4     dwParam     Message parameter
  0x14    4     dwMsgType   Message type ID
  0x18    4     dwSubType   Message sub-type

Magic Numbers:
  0x52 - Quest init message type
  0x4B - Progress update message type
  0x6fcc84b0 - State handler callback
  0x6fcc7d90 - Quest state callback
  0x6fcc7d20 - Unit iteration callback
  0x1B1, 0x1B5 - Debug log line numbers

functions.name: ProcessLamEsenQuestObjectComplete
functions.comment:
State callback for Lam Esen's Tome quest object activation.

Algorithm:
1. Check if object type at message+0x8/+0x4 equals 0xFF (completion trigger)
2. Verify quest data state at handler+0x18/+0x4 equals 1 (active)
3. Clear quest progress flag at handler+0x14
4. Call SetQuestStateAndIterate to set state 2 with callback 0x6fcc7d90
5. Clear data state flag at handler data +0x4
6. Clear state callback pointer at handler+0xA8
7. Iterate all units via SetNpcTradeFlagsFromMonsterClass

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX) - Quest handler structure
  pMessage (EDX) - Quest event message structure

Returns: void

Quest Handler Offsets:
  +0x04: pGame - Game state pointer
  +0x14: bProgressFlag - Quest progress tracking
  +0x18: pQuestData - Quest data structure pointer
  +0xA8: pfnStateCallback - State callback pointer (cleared on complete)

Magic Numbers:
  0xFF - Object activation type for quest completion
  0x01 - Quest active state requirement
  0x02 - New quest state after completion
  0x6fcc7d90 - Quest iteration callback address

functions.name: HandleQuestKhalimNpcInteraction
functions.comment:
Handles NPC interaction for Khalim's Will quest (Act 3 Q3).

Algorithm:
1. Get player bit array from monster class ptr using char slot index
2. Check if quest already complete (stat 0x15/0 set) - exit if so
3. If NPC type 0xFF with subtype 0x252:
   - Check if quest flag 0x11/0xD set (previous quest done)
   - Set quest state 2 or 3 based on flag, mark data+4=1
   - Send quest text to client
4. If NPC type 0xF5 with subtype 0x272 (Cain):
   - If flag 0x15/4 set (quest items collected):
     - If flag 0x12/0 set, remove all Khalim body part items
     - If flag 0x15/0xD set and state != 7: finalize quest state
     - Validate and call sequence callback
     - Set flag 0x15/0, clear flag 0x15/4
     - Add player GUID to completion array
     - Send quest text to client

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest info structure pointer:
    +0x0C: Current quest state (char)
    +0x14: Quest iterator byte
    +0x18: Pointer to quest data (+4 = activation flag)
    +0x1C: Player completion array
    +0xEC: Sequence callback function pointer
  pQuestContext (EDX) - Quest context array pointer:
    +0x00: pGame - Game instance pointer
    +0x0C: pPlayer - Player unit pointer
    +0x14: nNpcType - NPC type code (short)
    +0x18: nNpcSubtype - NPC subtype code (short)

Returns: void

Decompiler Notes:
  extraout_var (undefined3) - Phantom variable from CONCAT31 operation.
  Ghidra extends bool return of IsQuestNpcTradeFlagSet to 32-bit for
  comparison. This is a decompiler artifact, not an actual variable.

Magic Numbers:
  0xFF - NPC type for quest giver
  0x252 - Subtype for initial quest dialog
  0xF5 - Cain NPC type
  0x272 - Subtype for Cain quest completion
  0x15 - Khalim's Will quest stat ID
  0x12 - Item collection stat ID  
  0x11 - Previous quest stat ID
  0x1F7 - Assert line for callback validation

Quest Items (Khalim body parts):
  0x20796571 "qey " - Khalim's Eye
  0x20726871 "qhr " - Khalim's Heart
  0x20726271 "qbr " - Khalim's Brain
  0x20316671 "qf1 " - Khalim's Flail
  0x20326671 "qf2 " - Quest flag 2

functions.name: ValidateLamEsenQuestSequence
functions.comment:
Validates the Lam Esen quest sequence state and executes its callback.

Checks whether the quest is still active and in valid progress state. If the quest
is complete (state 7) or inactive, locates the quest client and validates the
sequence callback pointer before executing it.

Algorithm:
1. Check quest state at offset +0xC - if not 7 (complete), proceed to step 2
2. Check active flag at offset +0x9 - if non-zero, return true (quest in progress)
3. Find quest client using FindClientById with game pointer at +0x4 and client ID at +0x10
4. If no client found, return false (validation failed)
5. Validate callback pointer at offset +0xEC using IsBadCodePtr
6. If callback pointer is invalid, trigger assertion and exit via ReportError(-1)
7. Execute sequence callback through client vtable at offset +0xEC (0x3b * 4)
8. Return callback result as boolean

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Pointer to QuestSequenceInfo structure containing:
    +0x04 pClientList: Pointer to game/client list for FindClientById lookup
    +0x09 byActiveFlag: Active flag (byte) - non-zero if quest is currently active
    +0x0C byQuestState: Quest state (byte) - 7 indicates quest complete
    +0x10 dwClientId: Client ID (dword) for locating the quest client
    +0xEC pfnSequenceCallback: Sequence callback function pointer

Returns:
  true  - Quest is still in valid progress (state != 7 and active flag set)
  true  - Sequence callback executed successfully and returned non-zero
  false - No client found for the given client ID
  Does not return if callback pointer validation fails (triggers assertion)

Special Cases:
  - Early exit with true if quest state != 7 AND active flag is set
  - Assertion failure calls ReportError(-1) which terminates the game

Magic Numbers:
  0x07 (7)   - Quest complete state value
  0x21B (539) - Source line number for assertion
  0x3B (59)  - Vtable index for sequence callback (offset 0xEC / 4)
  0xEC (236) - Offset to callback pointer in both quest info and client structures

functions.name: InitializeKhalimQuestStateFromFlags
functions.comment:
Initializes Khalim's Will quest state based on player's NPC trade flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class trade flag array via character slot index
2. Check flag 0x12/0 (quest interaction) - set data+0xC=1 if active
3. Check flags 0x15/0 or 0x15/4 (quest complete) - if set, mark 0x15/0xD and return
4. Store flag 0x11/0 result at data+0x8 for subsequent checks
5. Based on flags 0x15/2 (eye), 0x15/3 (brain) and 0x11/0 (heart):
   - 0x15/2=0, 0x15/3=0: No organs collected
   - 0x15/2=1, 0x15/3=0, 0x11=0: Eye only -> state 3, stage 2
   - 0x15/2=1, 0x15/3=0, 0x11=1: Eye+Heart -> state 2, stage 2
   - 0x15/2=x, 0x15/3=1, 0x11=1: Eye+Heart+Brain -> state 4, stage 3
   - 0x15/2=0, 0x15/3=1, 0x11=0: Brain only -> state 5, stage 3

Parameters:
  pQuestInfo (ECX) - Quest info structure:
    +0x04: pGame pointer
    +0x09: Quest active flag
    +0x0B: Quest stage number
    +0x0C: Quest state number
    +0x18: Quest data pointer
  pQuestContext (EDX) - Quest context:
    +0x00: pGame pointer
    +0x0C: Player character slot

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x11 - Heart organ stat index
  0x12 - Quest interaction stat index
  0x15 - Khalim's Will quest stat index
  0x4D - Character slot offset in game structure

Quest States (param_1+0xC):
  2 - Eye and Heart collected
  3 - Eye only collected
  4 - All organs (Eye+Heart+Brain)
  5 - Brain only

Quest Stages (param_1+0xB):
  2 - Partial collection
  3 - Advanced collection

functions.name: ValidateQuestNpcProximityAndSetFlags
functions.comment:
Validates player proximity to quest NPC and sets quest completion flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class and trade flags array using char slot index
2. Get player room and verify it exists
3. Check if NPC trade flags 0x15/0 and 0x15/4 are not already set
4. Get character tier index from room entity; require tier 2 (Nightmare+)
5. Find quest client by ID 0x13 and get linked NPC unit by GUID
6. Verify NPC unit exists and has valid room
7. Check room proximity:
   a. Direct match: player room equals NPC room
   b. Adjacent match: iterate player room tile list for NPC room
8. If rooms match, get monster class and check stat 0x12/0 flag
9. Set flag 0x15/4 if stat 0x12/0 is clear, else set 0x15/0
10. Set completion flag 0x15/0xD

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer with char slot at +0x4D
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit to check proximity for

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - Quest NPC trade flag stat ID
  0x12 - Secondary interaction flag stat ID
  0x13 - Quest client ID for NPC lookup
  0x0D - Completion flag bit position
  0x02 - Nightmare+ character tier requirement
  0xE2 - Assert line number for room validation

Error Handling:
  Asserts if player room is NULL after initial check (hPlayerRoom)

functions.name: IterateLamEsenQuestPartyRewards
functions.comment:
Iterates party members to distribute Lam Esen quest rewards.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's monster class pointer for trade flag access
2. Check if NPC trade flag 0x15 bit 0xD is set (quest completion flag)
3. If flag set, get player's party slot index
4. If player is in a party (slot != -1), iterate all party members
5. Call FUN_6fcc7e00 callback to apply rewards to each member

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer containing character slot at +0x4D
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit to check and iterate party for

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - Lam Esen quest NPC trade flag stat ID
  0x0D - Quest completion bit position in flag array
  0x4D - Character slot index offset in game data
  -1 (0xFFFF) - No party / solo player indicator

Callback:
  FUN_6fcc7e00 - Applied to each party member to set completion flags

functions.name: SetLamEsenQuestTradeFlags
functions.comment:
Sets NPC trade flags for Lam Esen quest completion on a player unit.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer from unit
2. Get bit array from class at character slot index +4
3. Check if NPC trade flag 0x15/0 already set - if so, return
4. Check if NPC trade flag 0x15/4 already set - if so, return
5. Set bit 0x15/0xE in player's trade flag array
6. Send item effect notification if level below threshold

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer (offset +0x4D has char slot)
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit to update trade flags

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x15 - Lam Esen quest NPC trade flag stat ID
  0x0E - Completion flag bit position
  0x4D - Character slot index offset in game structure

Note: Called as unit iteration callback from HandleLamEsenQuestBossKill

functions.name: CheckLamEsenQuestItemRequirements
functions.comment:
Checks Lam Esen quest item requirements and tracks progress counters.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's room and verify not null
2. Get entity field and validate experience value
3. Check character tier index equals 2 (Nightmare difficulty)
4. Find quest client by ID 0x13 (Lam Esen quest)
5. Get player monster class and check NPC trade flag 0x12/0
6. If flag not set, search for quest items:
   - "qf1 " (0x20316671) - Quest flag 1 item
   - "qf2 " (0x20326671) - Quest flag 2 item
   - If neither found, increment counter at client data +0x3C
7. Search for "box " item (0x20786f62) - Horadric Cube/container
8. If box not found, increment counter at client data +0x40

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer with char slot at +0x4D
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit to check inventory

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x13 - Lam Esen quest client ID
  0x12 - NPC trade flag stat ID for quest progress
  0x02 - Nightmare difficulty tier requirement
  0x20316671 - "qf1 " quest flag 1 item stat
  0x20326671 - "qf2 " quest flag 2 item stat
  0x20786f62 - "box " container item stat
  0x3C - Quest item missing counter offset
  0x40 - Container missing counter offset

functions.name: IsQuestObjectInteractionAllowed
functions.comment:
Checks if quest object interaction is allowed for the given unit.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest client by ID 0x13 (quest type identifier)
2. Get room entity from unit
3. If room exists and entity field equals 0x65, return false (blocked)
4. If no quest client found, return false
5. Return true if quest data +0xC flag is 0 (quest not complete)

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer
  pUnit (EDX) - Unit attempting interaction

Returns:
  true - Interaction allowed (quest active and not blocked by room)
  false - Interaction blocked (wrong room type or quest complete)

Magic Numbers:
  0x13 - Quest client ID for this quest type
  0x65 - Room entity field value that blocks interaction
  0x0C - Quest completion flag offset in client data

Note: Called from DispatchLevelSpecificHandler for quest object validation

functions.name: FUN_6fd131b0
functions.signature: bool FUN_6fd131b0(int param_1, int param_2, undefined4 param_3, undefined4 param_4)

functions.name: UpdateQuestActProgressForPlayer
functions.comment:
Updates quest act progress for a player when completing a quest objective.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer and bit array
2. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16/0 already set - if so, return early
3. Get room entity from player unit
4. Verify room exists and character tier equals 2 (Nightmare+)
5. Set completion bits in trade flag array:
   - 0x16/0xD - Main completion flag
   - 0x16/0 - Primary completion
   - 0x16/0xB - Secondary completion
6. Get player client data and update act progress (act 3)
7. Find quest client by ID 0x14, increment counter at +0x1C

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer (+0x4D has character slot)
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit receiving progress update

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - Quest stat ID for this quest type
  0x14 - Quest client ID
  0x02 - Character tier requirement (Nightmare difficulty)
  0x03 - Act index for progress update
  0x4D - Character slot index offset

Note: Called as iteration callback for quest completion processing

functions.name: HandleQuestObjectAnimationCallback
functions.comment:
Handles quest object animation callback for quest client ID 0x14.

Algorithm:
1. Find quest client by ID 0x14 from game state
2. Get entity field from player unit
3. If entity field is 0x68 (special state):
   - Set object animation mode to 2 and return
4. If quest client found:
   - Get client data at +0x18 (piVar2[6])
   - Set flag at data+1 to 1
   - Copy object GUID from unit+8 to data+4
   - Set object animation mode from data+0xC

Parameters:
  pQuestChain (ECX) - Quest chain structure:
    [0]: pGame
    [1]: pObject (quest object unit)
    [2]: pPlayer

Returns: void

Quest Client Data Structure (at client+0x18):
  +0x01: fActivated flag
  +0x04: dwObjectGuid
  +0x0C: nAnimationMode

Magic Numbers:
  0x14 - Quest client ID
  0x68 - Entity field value for special animation state
  2 - Default animation mode for special state

functions.name: CollectBlackbookQuestStats
functions.comment:
Collects quest stats for Blackbook quest based on NPC trade flags and quest state.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer and trade flags array
2. Check NPC trade flag 0x16 bits 0, 0xD, and 0xB
3. If flag 0x16/0xB set: collect stats type 5 and return
4. If flag 0x16/0 set and player in value array: collect stats type 6
5. If quest state < 6: use lookup table DAT_6fd3fa30 for stat type index
6. If quest state >= 6 and flag 0x16/0xD set: collect stats type 6

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX) - Quest handler structure pointer
  pQuestContext (EDX) - Quest context with game/player/unit data:
    [0]: pGame
    [2]: pUnit (field +4 has entity type)
    [3]: pPlayer
    [5]: pStatsList

Returns: void

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - Blackbook quest NPC trade flag stat ID
  0x4D - Character slot index offset
  0x38 - Quest handler stat ID offset
  DAT_6fd3fa30 - Quest state to stat type lookup table

functions.name: SetBlackbookQuestProgressFlags
functions.comment:
Sets Blackbook quest progress flags based on quest client state.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer and bit array
2. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16/0 or 0x16/0xB already set - if so, skip
3. Find quest client by ID 0x14
4. Based on client state at offset +0xC (piVar3[3]):
   - State 2: Set bit 0x16/2
   - State 3: Set bit 0x16/3
   - State 4: Check sub-state at +0xB:
     - Sub 2: Set bit 0x16/4
     - Sub 3: Set bit 0x16/5
     - Sub 4: Set bit 0x16/6
   - State 5: Check sub-state at +0xB:
     - Sub 2: Set bit 0x16/7
     - Sub 3: Set bit 0x16/8
     - Sub 4: Set bit 0x16/9

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game state pointer (offset +0x4D has char slot)
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit to update flags

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - Blackbook quest NPC trade flag stat ID
  0x14 - Quest client ID for Blackbook quest
  0x4D - Character slot index offset

functions.name: CheckAndSendBlackbookQuestPacket
functions.comment:
Callback for Blackbook of Summoning quest to validate progress flags and send packet.

Algorithm:
1. Get player's MonsterClass trade flags array via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
2. Calculate flag index from pGame[0x4D] + 4 to get correct difficulty slot
3. Check NPC trade flag 0x16 bit 0 (quest started)
4. If not set, check NPC trade flag 0x16 bit 0xF (alternate start)
5. If either flag is set:
   - Check NPC trade flag 0x16 bit 0xD (completion blocked)
   - Check NPC trade flag 0x16 bit 0xE (completion blocked alt)
6. If both blocking flags are clear, return early without packet
7. Otherwise, send quest state packet 0x14 to player

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - GameState structure pointer, +0x4D contains difficulty index
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit pointer (int* cast from UnitAny*)

Returns: 0 always (callback convention - return value ignored by caller)

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - NPC trade flag stat ID for Blackbook quest
  0x00 - Quest started flag bit
  0x0F - Alternate quest started flag bit
  0x0D - Completion blocked flag bit
  0x0E - Completion blocked alternate flag bit
  0x14 - Quest state packet type for status update
  0x4D - Game struct offset for difficulty index

Note: extraout_var* are decompiler artifacts from CONCAT31 checking full EAX after
bool return in AL. IsNpcTradeFlagSet returns bool but decompiler shows full register check.

functions.comment: Setting prototype: void CheckBlackbookUnitStateCallback(int *pQuestHandler, UnitAny *pUnit)

functions.name: UpdateBlackbookQuestCompletion
functions.comment:
Callback to update Blackbook of Summoning quest completion flags.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class trade flags array
2. Get player's current room
3. If room is null, exit early
4. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16/0 is already set - if so, exit
5. Get entity field from room, verify value is 0x66
6. Find client by ID 0x14 (quest packet type)
7. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16/0xB is set - if so, exit
8. Set completion flags: 0x16/0xD, 0x16/0, 0x16/0xB
9. Update act progress to stage 3 for current act
10. Increment quest completion counter at client[6]+0x1C

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game structure pointer, +0x4D contains act index
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit pointer

Returns: Always 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - Quest trade flag stat ID (Blackbook quest)
  0x66 - Required entity field value for completion
  0x14 - Quest client ID for packet lookup
  0x0B - Progress milestone flag bit
  0x0D - Completion flag bit
  0x4D - Act index offset in game structure

functions.name: UpdatePartyQuestActProgress
functions.comment:
Updates quest act progress for all party members when NPC trade flag is set.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player's monster class data pointer
  2. Read quest act index from nQuestContext offset 0x4D
  3. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16 (22) is set with mode 0xD (13)
  4. If flag set and player is in a party (slot != -1):
     - Iterate all party members calling UpdateQuestActProgressForPlayer

Parameters:
  nQuestContext (ECX) -- Quest context structure pointer
  pUnit (EDX)         -- Player unit to check party membership

Returns:
  0 -- Always returns 0 (success)

Special Cases:
  - No action if NPC trade flag not set
  - No action if player not in party (slot == -1)

functions.name: SetBlackbookQuestCompletionFlags
functions.comment:
Callback to set Blackbook of Summoning quest completion trade flags.
Called during unit iteration to mark quest completion for a player.

Algorithm:
1. Get player monster class pointer via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
2. Calculate trade flags array using game act index at pGame+0x4D
3. Check if NPC trade flag 0x16/0 already set - if so, exit early
4. Check if progress milestone flag 0x16/0xB already set - if so, exit
5. If both checks pass:
   a. Set quest completion flag 0x16/0xE via SetBitInArray2D
   b. Send item effect via SendItemEffectIfLevelBelow

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game structure pointer, +0x4D contains act index
  pPlayer (EDX) - Player unit pointer

Returns: Always 0 (success)

Magic Numbers:
  0x16 - Quest trade flag stat ID (Blackbook quest)
  0x00 - Base quest flag bit
  0x0B - Progress milestone flag bit
  0x0E - Completion flag bit
  0x4D - Act index offset in game structure

functions.name: EnableBlackbookUnitStateCheck
functions.comment:
Enables the Blackbook unit state check callback for a quest handler.

Algorithm:
  1. Check if quest handler's active flag (offset 0xC) is clear
  2. Check if quest handler's enabled flag (offset 0x9) is set
  3. If both conditions met, set active flag to 1
  4. Install CheckBlackbookUnitStateCallback at handler offset 0xA8

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX) -- Pointer to QuestChain structure

Returns:
  1 -- Always returns success

Special Cases:
  - Callback only installed if handler not already active and is enabled
  - Silently succeeds even if callback not installed

functions.name: DetermineQuestStateFromNpcFlags
functions.comment:
Determines quest state/stage values based on NPC trade flag checks.

Algorithm:
  1. Extract quest context pointer from pnPartyMemberData[0]
  2. Get player's monster class pointer via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
  3. Read act index from quest context offset 0x4D
  4. Check NPC trade flags in priority order via IsNpcTradeFlagSet:
     - Flags 0x16:0, 0x16:0xB, or 0x17:0 -> Set quest bit 0x16:0xD, state=2
     - Flag 0x16:9 -> stage=5, substage=4
     - Flag 0x16:8 -> stage=5, substage=3
     - Flag 0x16:7 -> stage=5, substage=2
     - Flag 0x16:6 -> stage=4, substage=4
     - Flag 0x16:5 -> stage=4, substage=3
     - Flag 0x16:4 -> stage=4, substage=2
     - Flag 0x16:3 -> stage=2, substage=2
     - Flag 0x16:2 -> stage=3, substage=2
  5. Write stage to nQuestState+0xC, substage to nQuestState+0xB

Parameters:
  nQuestState       (ECX) - Quest state structure pointer
  pnPartyMemberData (EDX) - Party member data array

Returns:
  void - Modifies nQuestState structure in place

Structure Layout (QuestState):
  Offset  Size  Field     Description
  0x04    4     pPlayer   Player unit pointer
  0x0B    1     substage  Quest substage value
  0x0C    1     stage     Quest stage value
  0x18    4     pState    State pointer for completion

functions.name: ResetQuestUnitAnimations
functions.comment:
Resets animation modes for quest-related units.

Algorithm:
  1. Find client by ID 0x14 (quest client identifier)
  2. Get quest data structure from client[6]
  3. Reset state fields at offsets 0xC and 0x10 to value 2
  4. If flag at offset 1 is set, find unit by GUID at offset 4 and set animation mode 1
  5. If flag at offset 2 is set, find unit by GUID at offset 8 and set animation mode 2

Parameters:
  nGame (ECX) -- Game instance handle

Returns:
  void

Quest Data Structure (at pClient[6]):
  Offset | Size | Field         | Description
  -------|------|---------------|----------------------------------
  0x01   | 1    | bUnit1Active  | Flag: first unit needs anim reset
  0x02   | 1    | bUnit2Active  | Flag: second unit needs anim reset
  0x04   | 4    | dwUnit1Guid   | GUID of first quest unit
  0x08   | 4    | dwUnit2Guid   | GUID of second quest unit
  0x0C   | 4    | dwState1      | State field (reset to 2)
  0x10   | 4    | dwState2      | State field (reset to 2)

Special Cases:
  - Returns early if client ID 0x14 not found
  - Unit animation only set if corresponding flag is non-zero and unit found

functions.name: SpawnQuestMonsterAtWaypoint
functions.comment:
Spawns a quest monster at a waypoint location based on quest data.

Algorithm:
  1. Find client by ID 0x1C (28) from game pointer in pnQuestData[0]
  2. Get waypoint data structure from client offset 0x18 (piVar2[6])
  3. If waypoint flag byte[1] is set (active waypoint):
     a. Calculate spawn X = pnQuestData[5] + 7
     b. Get spawn Y = pnQuestData[6]
     c. Store coordinates in waypoint data at offsets 4 and 8
     d. Find region containing spawn coordinates
     e. Spawn monster ID 0x170 (368) at coordinates with parameters (1, -1, 0, SI)
     f. If spawn successful, clear waypoint active flag (byte[1] = 0)
  4. Set waypoint enabled flag (byte[0] = 1)

Parameters:
  pnQuestData (ECX) - Quest data array:
    [0] = Game pointer
    [2] = Region/area data
    [5] = Base X coordinate
    [6] = Y coordinate

Returns:
  void - Modifies waypoint data structure in place

Magic Numbers:
  0x1C (28) - Client ID to search for
  0x170 (368) - Monster class ID to spawn
  0x07 - X coordinate offset added to base position

functions.name: InitializeQuestStateData
functions.comment:
Initializes quest state data structure with default values and callbacks.

Algorithm:
  1. Clear 15 dwords (0x3C bytes) starting at pQuestState+0xA0
  2. Clear additional state fields at offsets 0xDC, 0xC, 0xB
  3. Set handler callback at offset 0xD4 to FUN_6fcc9fd0
  4. Set initialization flag at offset 0xA to 1
  5. Allocate 0x14 bytes (20 bytes) from pool memory for waypoint data
  6. Store waypoint data pointer at offset 0x18
  7. Clear all 5 dwords in waypoint data structure
  8. Set quest type at offset 0xE0 to 0x10
  9. Set start/end callbacks at offsets 0xE4 and 0xE8 to FUN_6fccd690
  10. Set waypoint enabled flag at waypoint_data+1 to 1

Parameters:
  pQuestState (ECX) - Pointer to quest state structure to initialize

Returns:
  void - Modifies pQuestState structure in place

Structure Layout (pQuestState):
  Offset  Size  Field           Type        Description
  0x04    4     pPlayer         pointer     Player pointer for pool memory
  0x0A    1     fInitialized    byte        Initialization flag (set to 1)
  0x0B    1     bSubstage       byte        Quest substage (cleared to 0)
  0x0C    1     bStage          byte        Quest stage (cleared to 0)
  0x18    4     pWaypointData   pointer     Allocated waypoint data (0x14 bytes)
  0xA0    0x3C  abStateData     byte[60]    Quest state data (cleared to 0)
  0xD4    4     pfnHandler      code*       Handler callback function
  0xDC    4     dwUnknown       dword       Unknown field (cleared to 0)
  0xE0    4     dwQuestType     dword       Quest type identifier (0x10)
  0xE4    4     pfnStart        code*       Quest start callback
  0xE8    4     pfnEnd          code*       Quest end callback

functions.name: HandleQuestNpcTradeCheck
functions.comment:
Handler callback that checks NPC trade flags and updates quest state.

Algorithm:
  1. Extract quest context from pnPartyMemberData[0]
  2. Get player's monster class pointer from pnPartyMemberData[3]
  3. Read act index from quest context+0x4D to index into monster class data
  4. Check NPC trade flag 0x20:0
  5. If flag is set:
     - Set quest bit 0x20:0xD for the player
     - Clear waypoint enabled flag at pQuestState+0x18+1

Parameters:
  pQuestState       (ECX) - Quest state structure pointer
  pnPartyMemberData (EDX) - Party member data array; [0]=quest context, [3]=unit pointer

Returns:
  void - Modifies pQuestState in place

Magic Numbers:
  0x4D - Offset to act index in quest context
  0x20 - Quest flag identifier
  0x0D - Quest completion bit to set

functions.name: CheckQuestTierRequirement
functions.comment:
Checks if a unit meets the tier requirement for a quest and sets flag if valid.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class data pointer for the unit
  2. Read act index from nQuestContext+0x4D to index into monster class data
  3. Check if NPC trade flag 0x20:0 is already set
  4. If flag not set:
     a. Get the unit's room
     b. If room exists, get entity field (experience value)
     c. If experience non-zero, get character tier index
     d. If tier index equals 2 (char '\\x02'), set bit 0x20:0 in the trade flags

Parameters:
  nQuestContext (ECX) - Quest context pointer; +0x4D contains act index
  pUnit         (EDX) - Unit pointer to check tier requirement for

Returns:
  0 - Always returns 0

Magic Numbers:
  0x4D - Offset to act index in quest context
  0x20 - Quest flag identifier for tier check
  0x02 - Required tier index value

functions.name: InitializeQuestType18Data
functions.comment:
Initializes quest state data for quest type 0x18.

Algorithm:
  1. Clear 15 dwords (0x3C bytes) starting at pQuestState+0xA0
  2. Set handler function pointer at offset 0xA0 to FUN_6fcca240
  3. Set callback function at offset 0xCC to FUN_6fcca200
  4. Set data pointer at offset 0xDC to DAT_6fd3fc68
  5. Set initialization flag at offset 0xA to 1
  6. Clear quest stage at offset 0xC to 0
  7. Clear quest substage at offset 0xB to 0
  8. Clear waypoint data pointer at offset 0x18 to NULL
  9. Set quest type identifier at offset 0xE0 to 0x18
  10. Set start callback at offset 0xE4 to FUN_6fccd690
  11. Set end callback at offset 0xE8 to FUN_6fcca290

Parameters:
  pQuestState (ECX) - Pointer to quest state structure to initialize

Returns:
  void - Modifies pQuestState structure in place

Structure Layout (pQuestState):
  Offset  Size  Field           Type        Description
  0x0A    1     fInitialized    byte        Initialization flag (set to 1)
  0x0B    1     bSubstage       byte        Quest substage (cleared to 0)
  0x0C    1     bStage          byte        Quest stage (cleared to 0)
  0x18    4     pWaypointData   pointer     Waypoint data (NULL for this type)
  0xA0    4     pfnHandler      code*       Main handler callback
  0xCC    4     pfnCallback     code*       Secondary callback
  0xDC    4     pData           pointer     Quest-specific data pointer
  0xE0    4     dwQuestType     dword       Quest type (0x18)
  0xE4    4     pfnStart        code*       Quest start callback
  0xE8    4     pfnEnd          code*       Quest end callback

functions.name: ClearQuestBitForMonsterClass
functions.comment:
Clears a quest bit in the player's monster class array for quest ID 0x18 (24).

Algorithm:
  1. Check if pActData[5] (quest ID low) == 0x16f (367)
  2. Check if pActData[6] (quest ID high) == 0x298 (664)
  3. If both match, get quest data pointer from pActData[0]
  4. Get player monster class pointer from pActData[3] (UnitAny)
  5. Clear bit 0x18 (24) in the 2D bit array at difficulty offset

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX) - Quest state data pointer (unused in this function)
  pActData (EDX) - Act callback data containing quest identifiers and unit reference

Returns:
  void - No return value

Special Cases:
  - Returns early if quest IDs don't match 0x16f and 0x298
  - Uses difficulty index from offset 0x4d in quest data

functions.name: CollectQuestStatsIfNpcUntraded
functions.comment:
Collects quest stats if NPC trade flag is not set for player class.

Algorithm:
  1. Check if quest type equals 0x16f (367) at context offset 0x8+0x4
  2. Get player monster class pointer from context offset 0xc
  3. Check NPC trade flag (0x18) for the player class
  4. If trade flag is NOT set, collect stats via CollectStatsByTypeToList

Parameters:
  pStatsArray (ECX): Pointer to stats output array
  pQuestContext (EDX): Pointer to quest context structure:
    - Offset 0x0: Quest data pointer
    - Offset 0x8: Quest info ptr (offset 0x4 = quest type)
    - Offset 0xc: Player UnitAny pointer
    - Offset 0x14: Stats pool linked list

Returns:
  void (populates pStatsArray with collected stats)

functions.name: UpdateQuestFlagsOnCharacterTier
functions.comment:
Updates quest completion flags based on character tier level.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player's monster class pointer from unit
  2. Get bit array pointer using quest offset 0x4d
  3. Check NPC trade flag at index 0x19, bit 0
  4. If flag not set, check bit 1 at same index
  5. If bit 1 not set, get room from unit
  6. Get entity field (experience value) from room
  7. Calculate character tier from experience
  8. If tier equals 3, set completion bits 0xd and 1, then clear slot range

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX): Quest data structure with offset 0x4d for class index
  pUnit (EDX): Player unit pointer

Returns:
  void

functions.name: ExecuteQuestSequenceCallback
functions.comment:
Checks if the quest sequence callback can be executed based on quest state flags.

This function is installed as a callback at offset 0xEC in the QuestHandler structure
by InitializeRadamentQuest. It validates quest state before allowing sequence execution.

Algorithm:
  1. Load quest status flag from QuestHandler offset 0x0C (byQuestStatus field)
  2. If status equals 5 (QUEST_STATUS_COMPLETE), return 0 (cannot execute)
  3. Load completion flag from QuestHandler offset 0x09 (byCompletionFlag field)
  4. If completion flag is zero (objectives not met), return 0 (cannot execute)
  5. Return 1 (callback can be executed)

Parameters:
  pQuestHandler (ECX): Pointer to QuestHandler structure containing quest state:
    - Offset 0x09: byCompletionFlag - non-zero when quest objectives are met
    - Offset 0x0C: byQuestStatus - quest state (5 = completed)

Returns:
  byte: 1 if sequence callback can execute (quest active with objectives met)
        0 if sequence callback cannot execute (quest already completed or objectives pending)

Magic Numbers:
  0x05 - QUEST_STATUS_COMPLETE: Quest has been fully completed
  0x09 - Offset of completion flag in QuestHandler structure
  0x0C - Offset of quest status in QuestHandler structure

Related Functions:
  - InitializeRadamentQuest: Installs this callback at QuestHandler+0xEC
  - Part of Radament quest (Quest ID 0x19) callback system

functions.name: GetFirstPlayerClass
functions.comment:
Returns the character class of the first player in the game.

Algorithm:
  1. Call FindClientById with game ptr and 0x17 (23 = player unit type)
  2. If no client found, return 0
  3. Access client struct field at offset 0x18 (pPlayerData pointer)
  4. Return byte at offset 0x13 within PlayerData (character class)

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game context pointer

Returns:
  byte - Character class (0-6) if player found, 0 if no player in game

Special Cases:
  Used by SpawnMonstersInRoom and ReactivateInactiveUnits to check
  if a player exists in special level type 0x6c (108)

functions.name: UpdateQuestNpcTradeStatus
functions.comment:
Updates quest NPC trade status flags based on client state for quest 0x1a (26).

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class pointer from unit
  2. Index into class array using offset from pQuestData + 0x4d as index
  3. Check if NPC trade flag for row 0x1a, column 0 is already set
  4. If flag is set (equals 1), skip update and return 0
  5. Find client by ID 0x17 (23) in quest data
  6. If client not found, return 0
  7. Check client state at offset 0xc:
     - If state == 2: Set bit (0x1a, 2) and return 0
     - If state == 3:
       - If byte at offset 0xb == 1: Set bit (0x1a, 3) and return 0
       - Otherwise: Set bit (0x1a, 4) and continue
  8. Return 0

Parameters:
  pQuestData (ECX) - Pointer to quest data structure
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit for monster class lookup

Returns:
  uint - Always returns 0

Special Cases:
  - Early exit if trade flag already set (prevents redundant updates)
  - Client ID 0x17 (23) must exist for state updates
  - Three possible bit states based on client progression: 2, 3, or 4

functions.name: CheckAndSendQuestStateToPlayer
functions.comment:
Checks quest state flags and sends quest status packet to player if conditions are met.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player's monster class pointer via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
  2. Access quest flags array at [pGame+0x4d] byte index offset
  3. Check quest 0x1a (26) flag states:
     - If flag 0 is set OR flag 0xf (15) is set
     - AND flag 0xd (13) is NOT set
     - AND flag 0xe (14) is NOT set
     - Then skip sending packet (return 0)
  4. Otherwise send quest state packet 0x17 (23) to player
  5. Always returns 0

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Pointer to game context structure
  pPlayer (EDX) - Pointer to player unit

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Special Cases:
  - Packet only sent if quest flags indicate incomplete state
  - Quest ID 0x1a (26) corresponds to a specific act quest

functions.name: EnableEveOfDestructionNpcInteraction
functions.comment:
Enables NPC interaction for the Eve of Destruction quest if not already enabled.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class data from the unit via GetPlayerMonsterClassPtr
  2. Extract NPC trade flags array using class index from event info at offset 0x4D
  3. Check if NPC trade flag for quest 0x1A (26), index 0 is already set via IsNpcTradeFlagSet
  4. If flag not set:
     a. Set bit at row 0x1A (26), column 0xE (14) in the trade flags array via SetBitInArray2D
     b. Send item effect 0x17 (23) to the player unit via SendItemEffectIfLevelBelow
  5. Return 0 (always succeeds)

Parameters:
  pEventInfo (ECX) - Pointer to event info structure containing NPC class index byte at offset 0x4D
  pUnit (EDX) - Pointer to the player UnitAny structure

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0 (success)

Special Cases:
  - If NPC trade flag is already set (BVar2 == 1), skips enabling (no-op)
  - Called as callback from IterateUnitsWithCallback in HandleQuestAreaTrigger

Magic Numbers Reference:
  0x4D - Offset in event info for NPC class index byte
  0x1A (26) - Eve of Destruction quest ID / trade flag row
  0x0E (14) - Trade flag column for NPC interaction enable
  0x17 (23) - Item effect ID for quest activation visual effect

functions.name: PropagateEveOfDestructionQuestToParty
functions.comment:
Propagates Eve of Destruction quest progress to party members.

Called as a unit iteration callback from HandleQuestAreaTrigger when players
enter the quest area. Checks if the unit has completed a specific quest
condition, then iterates through all party members to update their progress.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player's monster class pointer from unit data
  2. Calculate trade flags array index using quest index from game context (offset 0x4d)
  3. Check if NPC trade flag (group 0x1a, index 0xd) is set
  4. If trade flag set, get the unit's party slot ID
  5. If unit is in a party (slot != -1), iterate all party members
  6. Call ProcessEveOfDestructionQuestProgress callback for each party member
  7. Return 0 to continue unit iteration

Parameters:
  pGame (ECX) - Game context pointer containing quest index byte at offset 0x4d
  pUnit (EDX) - Player unit to check for quest condition and propagate from

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0 (continue iteration callback return value)

Special Cases:
  - Returns early with 0 if trade flag is not set (quest condition not met)
  - Returns early with 0 if unit is not in a party (party slot == -1)
  - Only propagates to party if both conditions are met

Magic Numbers:
  0x4d - Offset in game context for quest/act index byte
  0x1a (26) - NPC trade flag group identifier for quest checks
  0xd (13) - NPC trade flag index for Eve of Destruction quest state
  0x10 - Base offset for trade flags array in player stats
  -1 (0xFFFF) - Invalid party slot indicating unit not in party

functions.name: ProcessQuestItemRemovalAndComplete
functions.comment:
Processes quest 0x1b (27) item removal and completion for tier 3 characters.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class pointer and bit array
  2. Check if quest 0x1b flag 0 is already set; return if so
  3. Check if quest 0x1b flag 1 is already set; return if so
  4. Get room from player unit
  5. Get entity field and verify non-zero
  6. Check character tier index; proceed only if tier 3 (char == 3)
  7. Remove quest items with stat values:
     - 0x20686668 ("hhf " - quest item 1)
     - 0x2073736d ("mss " - quest item 2)
  8. Set quest 0x1b flags: 0xd (13), 1
  9. Clear slot bit range for quest 0x1b
  10. Find client by ID 0x18 (24)
  11. Increment counter at client state+0x14

Parameters:
  nGameId (ECX) - Game identifier
  pPlayerUnit (EDX) - Pointer to player unit

Returns:
  void

Special Cases:
  - Early return if quest flag 0 or 1 already set (quest complete)
  - Early return if room is null
  - Early return if entity field is zero
  - Only processes for tier 3 characters

functions.name: SendQuestStateIfFlagsNotSet
functions.comment:
Callback to send quest state packet to player if completion flags are not set.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class pointer from unit
  2. Get trade flags array from player stats at difficulty index offset
  3. Check quest 0x1b (27) flags:
     - If flag 0 (quest started) OR flag 0xf (15) is set AND
     - Flag 0xd (13 - reward claimed) is NOT set AND
     - Flag 0xe (14) is NOT set:
       Return 0 without sending packet (quest in progress, not complete)
  4. Otherwise send quest state packet with quest ID 0x18 (24)

Parameters:
  nGameId (ECX) - Game identifier with difficulty index at offset 0x4d
  pPlayerUnit (EDX) - Pointer to player unit

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0

Special Cases:
  - Skips sending packet if quest is started but reward not claimed
  - Used as iteration callback from SetQuestStateAndIterate

functions.name: CheckAndSetQuestItemEffectCallback
functions.comment:
Unit iteration callback that checks quest 0x1b (27) flags and sets item effect flag.

Algorithm:
  1. Get player monster class pointer from unit
  2. Get quest bit array from player stats at difficulty offset
  3. Check if quest 0x1b flag 0 (completion) is set - return 0 if so
  4. Check if quest 0x1b flag 1 (started) is set - return 0 if so
  5. If both flags not set:
     a. Set quest 0x1b flag 0xe (14) in bit array
     b. Call SendItemEffectIfLevelBelow to apply visual effect

Parameters:
  nGameId (ECX) - Game identifier
  pUnit (EDX) - Pointer to unit to check/update

Returns:
  int - Always returns 0 (continue iteration)
